description: Source code for the XCast plugin, implementing casting functionalities, event handling, and configuration persistence within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: XCast
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing casting control, event handling, and configuration management.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus and registers event handlers.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers and cleans up IARM bus connection.

methods.name: powerModeChange
methods.description: Handles power state change events and enables/disables cast service accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Activates the plugin, initializes the connector, and starts the cast location timer.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Shuts down the cast service and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information (none additional).

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the cast feature and persists the setting.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves the current cast enabled status.

methods.name: persistEnabledSettings
methods.description: Saves the cast enabled status to persistent storage.

methods.name: onLocateCastTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to attempt connecting to remote cast service with retries.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection from remote service and restarts the timer.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Handles application launch requests.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Handles application stop requests.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Handles application hide requests.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Handles application state requests.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Handles application resume requests.

methods.name: checkRFCServiceStatus
methods.description: Checks RFC feature status for cast enablement.

methods.name: checkXcastSettingsStatus
methods.description: Reads or initializes cast enablement setting from persistent storage.
